readings.Aries: You can start over. You've done it before. The question is whether that's what this requires. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Taurus: Your loyalty is not the issue. The question is whether it's being returned in kind. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Gemini: The quickest path through this is honesty, which will feel slow at first. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Cancer: There is love in your life that is waiting to be acknowledged. Notice it. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Leo: The recognition you crave is available in the form of self-recognition. It lasts longer. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Virgo: Your eye for what's wrong is excellent. Your eye for what's right — exercise it today. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Libra: The relationship that looks perfect from the outside is not being perceived from the inside. Which is true? The first instinct was right.
readings.Scorpio: The loyalty you extend to your own past version of events — check whether those events still hold. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Sagittarius: Your restlessness is valid. Right now, it is also the thing keeping you from what you want. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Capricorn: You've been holding the line. Today someone else can hold it while you rest. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Aquarius: Your version of intimacy is unusual and real. Someone is trying to understand it. Help them. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Pisces: The feeling you can't name is trying to tell you something that language hasn't caught up to yet. The window for this is shorter than it looks.

Aries-Aries.synthesis: Neither of you knows how to be small around the other. Decide if that's exhilarating or just exhausting.

Aries-Taurus.synthesis: One of you wants to move before it's ready. One of you wants to wait until it's certain. Neither will be satisfied.

Aries-Gemini.synthesis: Unique compound formed. Properties unpredictable — explore with caution.

Aries-Leo.synthesis: The warmth is real. So is the risk that you start competing over it rather than sharing it.

Aries-Virgo.synthesis: You work well when one agrees to be the foundation and the other agrees to be the spark. Agreement is the hard part.

Aries-Libra.synthesis: Unique compound formed. Properties unpredictable — explore with caution.

Aries-Scorpio.synthesis: The intensity is real. Whether it's connection or pressure depends on which day you're asking.

Aries-Aquarius.synthesis: Unique compound formed. Properties unpredictable — explore with caution.

Aries-Pisces.synthesis: One of you runs toward; one guards the door. The dance is interesting until someone gets tired.

Taurus-Taurus.synthesis: The practical language between you is fluent and efficient. The emotional one takes more effort from both.

Taurus-Cancer.synthesis: This tends to become quietly necessary to both people before either admits it.

Taurus-Aquarius.synthesis: Your different relationships with time are either the most useful thing about this or the most exhausting.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
